verdict.rationale: Navan documents its own expense policy and approval workflows. The pricing page lists "Unlimited policy and approval workflows". The MCP docs show transactions being flagged against policy, with the flag reason, the applicable policy and the required approver, plus per-category policy such as rideshare and hotel policy limits. The evidence never shows how rules are configured by category, role or context, and never confirms that in-policy expenses auto-approve while only exceptions reach a human. Missing for 10: documented rule configuration by category/role/context, explicit auto-approval of in-policy expenses with exception-only routing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
